day name: Second day of Beheading of the Honourable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptizer John; Our fathers among the saints Patriarchs of Constantinople Alexander, John, and Paul the Younger
name: John
Patriarchs of Constantinople Alexander, John, and Paul the Younger
type: Honourable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptizer
troparia: (Tone 2) The just man is remembered with praises,* but for you the Lord’s testimony suffices, O Forerunner,* for you truly became more honourable than the prophets* and were deemed worthy to baptize the One foretold.* Then you suffered for the truth and joyfully announced to those in Hades* that God appeared in the flesh, taking away the sin of the world,* and offering us great mercy.
(Tone 4) God of our fathers, You always treat us fairly.* Deprive us not of Your mercy,* but by their prayers direct our lives in peace.
kontakia: (Tone 5) The Forerunner's glorious beheading* came to be a form of dispensation divine* that he might proclaim to those in Hades* the message of the coming of the Saviour.* Let Herodias shed tears of lament* for a lawless murder that was her request;* for she loved a false and transitory age* rather than God's law and the age of life.

(Tone 8) O glorious saints, you were inflamed with love for Christ* and receiving your yoke - His cross -,* you proved yourselves to be imitators of His life and partakers of His glory,* O Alexander wise in God, wondrous John and glorious Paul!* Therefore, standing before His throne,* pray for our souls.
